🌟 smythos-studio | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Building, deploying, and managing intelligent AI agents through a visual, no-code to pro-code interface.
✨ Key Features: • Visual Agent Building • No-Code to Pro-Code Flexibility • Open Architecture for Deployment Anywhere • Intuitive Drag-and-Drop Interface • Real-Time Testing
📖 Summary: SmythOS Studio is an open-source visual AI agent builder and runtime stack. It offers an intuitive drag-and-drop interface for creating AI agent workflows, with the flexibility to extend with custom code and deploy agents across various environments with full governance.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 book-to-skill | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create structured, referenceable knowledge bases from technical books and documents that can be directly utilized by AI agents during work or study.
✨ Key Features: • Converts technical books and documents into agent skills • Supports multiple input formats (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI) • Enables on-demand loading of skills by AI agents • Reduces token usage compared to direct context inclusion
📖 Summary: Book-to-skill is a Python tool that transforms technical books and documents into structured agent skills. It enables AI agents to efficiently reference and utilize the information from these sources, overcoming the limitations of traditional PDF searching or direct context dumping.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 gridex | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a single, unified, and efficient application for developers and database administrators to connect to, query, and manage multiple types of databases across different operating systems.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux) • Support for multiple databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse)
📖 Summary: Gridex is a cross-platform database IDE for macOS, Windows, and Linux, supporting a wide range of databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, SQL Server, and ClickHouse. It offers a unified interface for managing these databases, featuring a built-in MCP server and AI chat capabilities.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
